messages.body_plain:
I've submitted R's organization application.

Google will begin reviewing these applications on Friday, February 14th.

Part of their review process is a review of project ideas posted by the
organization to gauge interest and level of organization.

R's project idea list for this year is here:

http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2014

Potential Mentors:  please post project ideas as soon as you can!

Potential Students: please contact potential mentors and help!

As always, feel free to contact me or one of the other program admins
with any questions.

Regards,

Brian

messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I am Shubham Singh Tomar. I'm a 3rd year student pursuing B.E in Chemical engineering. I am Interested in Machine learning and Data Science. I took Coursera's Computing for Data Analysis" course taught by Roger D. Peng. I think high-level languages like R and Python are great for prototyping models. I think it will be a few more weeks until there is an official list of project ideas & mentors but contributing to any of those projects would be a very strong point in an application.

Michael

messages.subject: Proposal for GSoC2014: Turning R objects into Pandoc's markdown with the pander package
messages.subject_clean: Proposal for GSoC2014: Turning R objects into Pandoc's markdown with the pander package
messages.body_plain:
Dear All,

I have just updated our project idea page on extending the current features of the "pander" package, that contains helper functions and a generic S3 method to render various types of R objects into markdown very easily inside or independently of knitr: http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2014:pander

Please let me know if you would be interested in contributing to this project, as I would be very happy to have someone on board who would boost the package development with great ideas and code.

On the other hand, please let me know if the project idea is not clear or would you need any further details.

Best,
Gergely

messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I am Prashant , from BITS Pilani , India , currently in my 3rd year of study of Engineering .I know following languages and have prior experience of working in them
C/C++,Java,Python
PHP,HTML,CSS,
Javascript,MySQL,
jQuery,Flotr.js,Angular.js

As a participant in GSOC 2014 I am interested in working on Interactive Visualization using rCharts.Although I dont have any prior experience of working with R or rCharts but after going through the above links a lot became clear about rCharts.From what I have understood the project is about creating a single unified interface using Javascript libraries.
while going through the rCharts following ideas popped up in my mind which can be corporated in the project(first draft we need to discuss these in details):
Addition of functionalities like Panning , Selective Zooming , Curve Tracing using flotr.js library
Exporting the rCharts as PDF.(A button to download them as pdf)
Incorporating more Javascript libraries like flotr.js which have specialized graphs
As of now as I dont have any prior experience of working in R or rCharts I would like to know what are the required levels of proficiency in them and what are the prerequisites for this project.
Hope my insights are useful.

with regards,
Prashant Kiran
